canonical_title: Complete or partial loss of an electrical subsystem

versions.title_at_revision: Complete or partial loss of an electrical subsystem
versions.text:
Standard: Complete or partial loss of an electrical subsystem results in handling qualities no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis to assess handling qualities following complete or partial loss of an electrical subsystem. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess handling qualities following complete or partial loss of an electrical subsystem. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess handling qualities following complete or partial loss of an electrical subsystem for selected combinations of air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE.
